# Quetext

> Quetext is an AI-powered plagiarism detection and academic integrity platform designed for educational institutions, students, and faculty.

Quetext provides comprehensive tools for detecting plagiarism and AI-generated content in academic settings. The platform integrates with popular cloud storage services like Google Drive and Microsoft OneDrive, and features DeepSearch technology to help institutions maintain academic integrity standards.

## Key Topics

- Plagiarism Detection
- AI Content Detection
- Academic Integrity
- DeepSearch Technology
- Educational Institutions
- Student Resources
- Faculty Tools
- Writing Tools
- Institutional Solutions
- Google Drive Integration
- Microsoft OneDrive Integration

## Education & Institutional Solutions

- [Educación | Quetext para escuelas y universidades](https://www.quetext.com/es/educacion): Quetext AI plagiarism detection and writing tools for schools, universities
